jdk.jfr.internal

注释类型 Cutoff


  • @Target(value=TYPE)
 @Inherited
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface Cutoff
    Event annotation, determines the cutoff above which an event should not be recorded, i.e. "20 ms". This settings is only supported for JVM events,

    • 字段概要

      字段 
      限定符和类型 字段和说明
      static String INIFITY 
      static String NAME
      Settings name "cutoff" for configuring event cutoffs.

    • 可选元素概要

      可选元素 
      限定符和类型 可选元素和说明
      String value
      Cutoff, for example "20 ms".

    • 字段详细资料

      • NAME

        public static final String NAME
        Settings name "cutoff" for configuring event cutoffs.

      • INIFITY

        public static final String INIFITY

    • 元素详细资料

      • value

        public abstract String value
        Cutoff, for example "20 ms".

        String representation of a positive Long value followed by an empty space and one of the following units

        "ns" (nanoseconds)
        "us" (microseconds)
        "ms" (milliseconds)
        "s" (seconds)
        "m" (minutes)
        "h" (hours)
        "d" (days)

        Example values, "0 ns", "10 ms" and "1 s". If the events has an infinite timespan, the text should be used.

        返回:
        the threshold, default "0 ns" not null
        默认值:
        "inifity"
